patient.name: 秋庭里香
patient.diagnosis: 成年AU的先天性 Ebstein 畸形，三尖瓣重度反流并伴右心室功能负担，拟行三尖瓣 Cone 重建。
patient.diagnosis_en: In this adult AU, congenital Ebstein anomaly causes severe tricuspid regurgitation and right ventricular strain; cone reconstruction of the tricuspid valve is planned.

day1.title: 我的心脏不是练习题
day1.title_en: My Heart Is Not a Practice Problem

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……你就是主刀医生？」
lines.text_en: “...So you are the surgeon?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「坂口。今天先说明检查结果和手术安排。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi. Today we will go over the test results and the operation plan.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「听说你准备把我的心脏重新缝一遍？」
lines.text_en: “I heard you are planning to stitch my heart back together?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「是修复三尖瓣。你的瓣叶附着位置异常，关闭时出现严重反流，我们要把瓣叶重新组合成合适的形状。」
lines.text_en: “We are repairing your tricuspid valve. Its leaflets are attached abnormally and allow severe regurgitation. We need to reshape and reconstruct them.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「说起来倒轻松。像在修一件衣服。」
lines.text_en: “You make it sound simple. Like mending a piece of clothing.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「实际难得多。要建立体外循环，重建瓣叶，还得检查心室和瓣环的关系。」
lines.text_en: “It is much harder. We need cardiopulmonary bypass, leaflet reconstruction and careful assessment of the ventricle and annulus.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那你最好找最会缝的助手。我的心脏可不是让你们练手的布料。」
lines.text_en: “Then you had better find the best assistants you have. My heart is not a piece of practice fabric.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这个要求很合理。我会按手术需要安排团队。」
lines.text_en: “That is a fair request. I will assemble the team for this operation.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……我可不是因为胆小才问这么多。」
lines.text_en: “...I am not asking all this because I am scared.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我也没有这么说。」
lines.text_en: “I did not say you were.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「听好了。我会醒来，然后亲自检查你的答卷。」
lines.text_en: “Listen carefully. I am going to wake up and inspect your work myself.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「那就请你严格一点。」
lines.text_en: “Then please grade us strictly.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「坂口！你总算来了。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi! You finally showed up.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「看来今天精神不错。」
lines.text_en: “You seem to have plenty of energy today.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我在等手术报告。我的瓣膜呢？」
lines.text_en: “I have been waiting for the operative report. How is my valve?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「Cone 重建完成了。术后观察仍然重要，不过目前的恢复符合预期。」
lines.text_en: “The cone reconstruction is complete. Follow-up remains important, but your recovery is proceeding as expected.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……你们真的把它重新做成了一个能正常工作的形状？」
lines.text_en: “...You really rebuilt it into a shape that can work properly?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「是整个团队一起完成的。」
lines.text_en: “The whole team did it together.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「哼。那你倒也不算完全没用。」
lines.text_en: “Hmph. Then I suppose you are not entirely useless.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「谢谢你的高度评价。」
lines.text_en: “Thank you for the glowing review.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……我刚才说的是，谢谢。」
lines.text_en: “...What I actually said was thank you.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「别只谢我。说不定是星见医院的神奇魔法在起作用。」
lines.text_en: “Do not thank only me. Maybe Hoshimi Hospital's magic was at work.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「哈？你是医生，怎么也说这种话。」
lines.text_en: “What? You are a doctor. How can you say something like that?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……不过，这次我就当它真的有魔法好了。」
lines.text_en: “...Still, this once I will pretend the magic is real.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「喂！还有，刚才那句话不许告诉别人！」
lines.text_en: “Hey! And do not tell anyone what I just said!”
